net.description: One square heavy marine capture net overlay for a 64x64 game board tile, straight-on view, centered. FOUR chunky nautical ropes running diagonally each way form a regular broad diamond fishing-net mesh, attached to four large knotted corners at (3,3), (60,3), (3,60), (60,60). The net extends edge to edge almost filling the entire 64x64 canvas; its outer rope perimeter follows a softly squared tile shape, NOT a small circle. Thick readable 4 to 5 pixel blue-green rope strands with dark edge separation and two restrained matte rope shades. Small desaturated purple barnacle/barb clusters belong at the corner knots only. Hollow transparent diamond windows between the cords must remain open so a colorful gem underneath can still be identified. No opaque backing, no gem, no terrain, no metal frame, no sharp jagged clutter, no faint thin lines, no glow, no blur. Crisp chunky native pixel-art clusters, dark clean contour and top-left light consistent with the style reference. Fill the square tile footprint; complete cords end in attached corner knots rather than cropped loose ends.
